name: Hatchet Self-Hosted
free_limit: Self-hosted MIT-licensed workflow orchestration engine for durable background tasks, scheduled jobs, retries and event-driven workflows; no software subscription or published per-run quota for the self-hosted deployment.
watch_out: Requires operating Hatchet server, PostgreSQL, workers and infrastructure. Hatchet Cloud pricing and payment-card requirements are separate; this entry does not include managed cloud runs.
